input.expected_observation: The Native worker returns baseline and best-found rollout metrics and objective; support would be a finite best rollout with lower objective than baseline, with task capability established only if terminal error is at most 0.01 m, holding maximum error is at most 0.01 m, and holding maximum speed is at most 0.03 m/s.
input.fixed_conditions: Keep candidate structure, MuJoCo model and configuration, target [0.295, 0, 0.215] m, 0.6 s duration, 0.001 s integration timestep, 0.02 s control/sample period, final holding window 0.06 s, and supplied full schedule source 63609c3249aad6f473cef22e3e9415a4aaa429a9d185367b10806054dbdc030b fixed. Use local_control_search_v2 with correction_window_s=0.20, knots_s=[0.40,0.50,0.60], at most 3 iterations and 24 Native callbacks; no surrogate, physical, NMPC, RL, or offline solver evidence.
input.hypothesis: Starting from the supplied unmeasured full control schedule, a bounded direct MuJoCo Native local control search over the final 0.20 s can reduce the sealed reach-and-hold objective and may satisfy the frozen endpoint and holding limits for this candidate in simulation.
input.interpretation: This is a local finite-budget simulation capability test anchored to an Operator-supplied unmeasured control schedule. Improvement is local evidence only; passing metrics would be simulation task evidence, not hardware truth.
input.stopping_condition: Stop this analysis after one admitted bounded Native search result or earlier numerical/admission failure; do not infer global optimality or infeasibility.
input.weakening_observation: No finite improvement within the bounded search, numerical failure, or a best rollout that still violates one or more frozen task limits weakens the capability hypothesis without proving infeasibility.

agent_hypothesis.expected_observation: Direct MuJoCo Native baseline and corrected rollouts show a lower best-found objective and report terminal error, final-window maximum error, and final-window maximum tip speed, with all callback and physics-step counts recorded.
agent_hypothesis.weakening_observation: No evaluated bounded correction improves the direct Native baseline, or numerical failure prevents a valid comparison within the admitted callback limit.
